status.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law. Amends the Illinois Procurement Code. Amends the Environmental Protection Act.

date.provenance: No specific date provided for the enactment of the law

pfas_definition.provenance: ‘Intentionally added PFAS chemical’ means a PFAS chemical that a PFAS manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that has a functional or technical effect on the product. ‘Intentionally added PFAS chemical’ includes a chemical that is produced through the decomposition of a PFAS chemical that a PFAS manufacturer has intentionally added to a product.
